concepts.name: Monte Carlo Tree Search
concepts.description: A heuristic search algorithm for decision processes combining tree search with Monte Carlo simulations.

concepts.name: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
concepts.description: Technique that trains a reward model from human comparisons to fine-tune language models.

concepts.name: Tree of Thoughts
concepts.description: A problem-solving framework that generalizes chain-of-thought to explore multiple reasoning paths.

concepts.name: Autonomous Agent Loop
concepts.description: An iterative execution cycle of perception, reasoning, tool execution, and self-correction.

concepts.name: Interactions API
concepts.description: Google GenAI API facilitating multi-turn stateful conversational interactions with implicit caching.

concepts.name: KV Cache
concepts.description: Cached key and value tensors across attention layers that avoid redundant recomputation during autoregressive token generation.

concepts.name: PagedAttention
concepts.description: An attention algorithm inspired by OS virtual memory paging that partitions the KV cache into non-contiguous fixed-size blocks.

concepts.name: Speculative Decoding
concepts.description: Inference acceleration technique where a fast draft model proposes candidate token sequences verified in parallel by the target LLM.

relations.description: Tree of Thoughts employs search heuristics inspired by Monte Carlo Tree Search.
Autonomous agents maintain stateful reasoning loops via the Interactions API.
PagedAttention eliminates contiguous memory fragmentation in KV Cache allocation.
Speculative Decoding verifies multiple drafted tokens in a single forward pass while reusing KV Cache prefix states.

claims.statement: Tree of Thoughts allows LMs to perform deliberate decision making by considering multiple paths.

evidence.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
evidence.exact_quote: Tree of Thoughts allows LMs to perform deliberate decision making by considering multiple different reasoning paths

claims.statement: PagedAttention partitions the KV cache of each sequence into blocks so memory is allocated on demand with near-zero internal fragmentation.

evidence.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
evidence.exact_quote: PagedAttention divides the sequence's KV cache into blocks, each of which can contain the attention keys and values for a fixed number of tokens
